You control three Clan Impersonations, in violation of the terms.
You should take the actions to burn them first (except for the Samedi
one, if you want to use Regenerative Blood. :-)

Use Camarilla Vitae Slave to increase Capacity without Discipline cards,
allowing an extra 2 damage (=38).

Use Blood Tears to gain blood in the first round and take 4 more damage
from the opponent's additional strike (=42).

If you want to get fancy, replace the Great Beast with a Blood Brother
and let the other members of that circle be controlled by someone else
(one of whom has Regenerative Blood via Clan Impersonation). You'll
have to lose the Concordance. But then each of the other Brothers can
play Brother's Blood to help deal with the incoming damage, making the
Agony much more Ecstatic. They can each have an enormous capacity if
they employ a series of Camarilla Vitae Slaves first, as well.
